note: CR-1c asks for the post-claim account view. The token redemption endpoint (GET /claim-account?token=...) is a frontend page that calls a backend token-consumption endpoint. The GuestClaimToken model has no Prisma relation back to ExperienceBooking (bookingId is a plain UUID field, not a @relation). The token consumption endpoint is not yet implemented in this cycle — G-5 scope is: (1) PAID booking → claim-account dispatch → GuestClaimToken created → magic link sent. The account creation step (token consumption → user creation → guestUserId backfill) is a forward work item.
g5_scope_boundary: G-5 as implemented: POST /:id/claim-account → creates GuestClaimToken → sends magic link email. Token consumption (account creation) is out of scope for this cycle.
